articles.title: A Standard Interface from LLM to Robot Actions
articles.summary: Hi ROS community, I’m working on ClawsJoy Robotics, a proposal for a standard interface between LLM-based cognitive systems and ROS/2 robots. The core idea: any LLM outputs an action, any robot implements these standard topics.

articles.title: How AI Navigation is Improving the Performance of Robotic Pool Cleaners
articles.summary: Robotic pool cleaners used to be judged mostly by suction, brushes, and how much debris they could collect. Those things still matter, but they are no longer the whole performance story. The bigger shift is navigation.

articles.title: Humanoid Announces its KinetIQ Ascend Reinforcement Learning Approach
articles.summary: The new system was tested on several tasks, including picking parts from bins, handing objects to humans, and lifting and moving containers using both arms. It has proven effective across a range of manipulation scenarios.

articles.title: Danish robotics startup enters the industrial truck market already crowned a winner
articles.summary: The Mobile Robot Company has won the IFOY Industrial Truck of the Year Award 2026 for a self-driving pallet jack designed to keep warehouse operators in control while automating repetitive transport work.
